capabilities: Link Magic: the Gathering cards by enclosing card names in square brackets
Fuzzy-match card names to resolve links
Specify a card set with [Card Name|Set Name]
Specify a collector number with [Card Name|Set Name|123]
extras: README is brief; it documents only the link syntax variants with no installation, settings, or display details.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to link to specific Magic: the Gathering cards, whose names are long, contain slashes, and have variants across sets.
summary: Link syntax plugin that turns square-bracketed Magic: the Gathering card names into card links, with fuzzy name matching and set/collector-number selectors.
